changelog:
- Initial release of the Code Simplification skill.
- Simplifies existing, working code by removing unnecessary abstractions, unused configuration, and needless indirection while keeping behaviour identical and verified.
- Produces two outputs: a simplified, smaller version of the code and a detailed ledger of all removals with justifications.
- Includes clear safety and verification disciplines, mandating behaviour-preserving changes and historical checks (Chesterton’s Fence).
- Provides a checklist to ensure quality and prevent destructive or speculative changes.
- Designed for use after features land, when cleaning up over-engineered AI-generated code, or in preparation for code review.
